correctness.rationale: Exact eigenvalues of a one-disk Fock Toeplitz operator yield λ0=1−e^{−s} and δ=se^{−s}. Factoring restrictions gives exact 2×2 coherent overlap λ0 e^{−d²/2}. The Hilbert–Schmidt cross-kernel bound η=s exp(−(d−2√s)²/2), a positive and norm-controlled Schur complement and min–max inertia give 0≤Λj−μj≤η²/(δ−2η) for both leading indices. Because η²=o(e^{−d²/2}) the sharp law follows. The reproduction script passes 16 deterministic checks; finite checks are not the infinite-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: For two equal disconnected Gaussian STFT concentration wells the limit has an exactly double dominant eigenvalue; an exponent and leading coefficient are necessary to resolve mode selection and concentration strength. The sharp tunneling law and a rigorously subordinate excited-state error provide a new quantitative structural statement about the natural two-component geometry, independent of translation or rotation.
